status: Secondary and exploratory analyses specified after the primary result was known.
outcomes_known_before_revision: original individual matched percentiles and mean 0.36883375029516285
uncentered raw contrast directions and original NT-centered directions
Preliminary approximate null quantiles and common-universe raw theta were available before specification.

primary_null.sampler: same whole-row duplicate rejection and batch size50000 as original transfer.py
primary_null.rejection_reference: strictly greater than empirical .95 quantile; empirical reference threshold, not exact finite-universe critical value or effect confidence limit
primary_null.histogram: 200 fixed-width bins on [0,1] plus compressed complete draw vector

no_hit_calibration.scope: same unrestricted random-set reference; not gene-specific probability of ineffectiveness

joint_matching.universe: all scored genes with original raw guide count and control/pretransplant meanCPM covariates
joint_matching.stratum: exact original guide_count, control quintile and pretransplant quintile; pd.qcut same as frozen raw analysis
joint_matching.reference: preserve nominee count k_s per disjoint stratum; uniformly sample k_s without replacement from full stratum including original nominees
joint_matching.statistic: sum_s (k_s/6)*theta_s where theta_s compares selected k_s to remaining n_s-k_s stratum genes using half-weight ties
joint_matching.collision_handling: draws within each stratum without replacement using whole-row rejection; strata partition universe so no across-stratum collisions
joint_matching.dependence: finite-population dependence within stratum retained; no estimate or correction for biological correlation across gene effects
joint_matching.inference: secondary upper-tail plus-one MonteCarlo p, MCSE, conditional strata-label exchangeability reference only

common_universe.universe: same11474 scored-and-raw-mapped genes, not separately chosen for each score
common_universe.statistic: same six-candidate finite theta within common universe
common_universe.checks: full rank vectors identical before/after constant shift; equality of raw theta; retain differing score signs
common_universe.scope: exploratory estimand comparison; no additional confirmatory pvalues

stylized_alternatives.universe: fixed11689 ordered signed-score ranks;6 nominated ranks per simulated set
stylized_alternatives.sampling: independent rank quantiles U_i ~ Beta(alpha_i,1); map floor(N*U_i) to ordered finite-universe genes; reject entire tuples with duplicates, conditioning each scenario on distinct ranks
stylized_alternatives.rejection: theta strictly greater than independently calibrated primary empirical .95 reference threshold
stylized_alternatives.reported: nominal independent rank-quantile mean before distinctness conditioning, actual simulated theta mean, rejection fraction and MonteCarlo standard error
stylized_alternatives.scope: conditional stylized finite-rank design sensitivity; not observed power, clinical probability or propagated experimental uncertainty

prohibited: no inversion of q-values to nominal p-values
no rescue claim from secondary analysis
no causal attribution to immune challenge class
